title: Industrial Relations Revival and Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Industrial Relations Revival and Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title, commencement and extent

ACT XV OF 2010
ACT XV OF 2010
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS
(REVIVAL AND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act to revive and amend the
Industrial
Relations Act, 2008
[Gazette.of
Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
5th July, 2010]
No. PAS/Legis-B-16/2010, dated 5-7-2010.---The
Industrial Relations (Revival and Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th June, 2010
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd July,
2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---In the interest of people of labour class, it is expedient to revive and amend the
Industrial Relations Act, 2008, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title, commencement and extent.---(1) This Act
may be called the Industrial Relations (Revival and Amendment) Act, 2010.
It shall extend to the whole of Province of Sindh.
It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed
to have taken effect on and from 1st days of May, 2010.
